user.title: Connect your Bright account
user.description: Use your existing Bright login. DCC data often arrives 24–48 hours late.

electricity.title: Choose electricity
electricity.description: Every active electricity resource is listed independently, including resources in different Virtual Entities.

gas.title: Choose gas
gas.description: Gas may come from a different Virtual Entity. Select None for electricity only.

costs.title: Historical cost resources
costs.description: Only cost streams in each selected meter's Virtual Entity are shown. If several exist, choose the corresponding stream. None keeps consumption enabled without costs.

confirm.title: Confirm meter selection
